rows.text: The Committee's resolution reproduces State Council of the USSR resolution No. ГС-13 of 14 November 1991: under the Law of 5 September 1991 and the Treaty on the Economic Community, the ministries and other central bodies of state administration of the USSR formed under the Law of 1 April 1991, and the bodies of state administration under the Cabinet of Ministers of the USSR listed in the annex, are to be abolished; they cease their management functions from 1 December 1991 and are to be wound up within two months, their heads continuing their duties while handing over.
rows.locator: Section I (the quoted text of ГС-13), points 1-2 and 6; annex

rows.text: Resolution No. 53 of 23 November 1991 announces ГС-13 'для сведения и руководства', obliges the Union ministries to implement it, sets up a coordinating commission reporting to the Interstate Economic Committee and to the Committee, and records ГС-13's instruction to the Interstate Economic Committee '(т. Силаеву И. С.)'; it is signed 'Руководитель Комитета И. Силаев'.
rows.locator: Section II, points 2-4, and signature; ГС-13 point 4 as quoted
